semanticDecisions: the nodes read a view whose charAt, length and toString return the subject's units; every subsequence, append, group and MatchResult still comes from Matcher.text

blocks of 1024 units are allocated and filled on first touch: an early failure or a short lookingAt pays one block (0.2..0.8 us per matcher), a full scan pays one bulk read per block; the first build's eager flat array made early failures O(n) and was rejected
a String above 16M units has no view and is read directly, as before; a non-String CharSequence is read directly, as before
the view is built on the first search or match and dropped by reset(CharSequence) when the text changes; usePattern and region keep it
SharedSecrets.getJavaLangAccess() may be null before System.initPhase1: the nodes then read the text
